frequency_counting.rule: wrong rule: A short simulation gives the exact page ranks. Right rule: freq[i]/T is only an estimate: about 10^n moves for n-digit precision and many more for accuracy.

math_random.quote: 5; Page 1 has probability 0.5; so in 10 steps the surfer goes there exactly 5 times
math_random.rule: wrong rule: A probability (e.g. 70%) predicts what the next single trial will do. Right rule: A probability describes the long-run frequency over many trials, not one outcome; Math.random() < 0.7 is true on about 70% of many calls, and any single call can go either way.
